svg.title: TCRen: statistical contact potentials, cohort ranking and structural exploration
svg.desc: Contact potentials support epitope ranking and measured affinity, response and kinetic associations. Receptor cohorts use ipTM I, Betti fraction B and enrichment M, with weights set by the frozen percentile of cohort-mean pLDDT. B=(E-V+C)/E. Local Fisher evidence F=-2 sum(log p_r) is calibrated against 2056 whole mock graphs using M=1-(1+count(F_j>=F))/(2056+1). Diagnostics explore geometry, contact contributions, enrichment and matched statistics.
